  "hypotheses": [
    {
      "explanation":"stolen_card",
      "likelihood":"high",
      "reasoning":"The foreign-issued card, failed CVV and failed identity/issuer verification support unauthorized payment use. The check outcome does not identify which component failed."
    },
    {
      "explanation":"legitimate_customer",
      "likelihood":"low",
      "reasoning":"A legitimate customer could use a foreign-issued card and enter CVV incorrectly; the established device and home delivery support that explanation. However, the failed verification decides the policy disposition."

  "disposition":"decline",
  "citations":["FP-2 §5.3(b)","FP-2 §5.2","FP-2 §6.6(b)","FP-2 §6.3","FP-2 §6.4","FP-2 §6.5(a)","R03"],
  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R03 holds because the German-issued card was used from a US IP and CVV failed. Card is the only adverse family; all other rule conditions are absent. No household exception changes the family count, and no earlier outcome settles the order. The foreign-issued card could belong to a legitimate customer using an established device and home delivery, but the failed id_check overrides the ordinary hold under §6.6(b). Under §5.3(b), decline is standard and escalation is prohibited without Linkage. The order remains unshipped, so decline voids and refunds it and blocks the account. No further check is needed."
